investigation_notes.Description: An Office 365 login for Fred.Mercedes@client.ee occurred from Johannesburg, South Africa. MFA was enabled and the login succeeded. Historical activity shows Johannesburg logins earlier in July and client confirmation that travel to South Africa was planned or occurred, suggesting this may be legitimate travel rather than an account compromise. The IP is not associated with VPN or proxy usage and belongs to a fixed-line ISP; overall pattern is consistent with the user’s known travel schedule, so the alert is classified as Low Priority. Past related alerts were closed as false positives after client-confirmed travel to South Africa.
